name: SAM DYAMOND Phase 2 simulation
size_as_stated: 10 d randomly selected from 40 d (last 30 d after 10 d spin-up), tropical ocean (20° S - 20° N), total number of samples on the order of 10^8
resolution: 4.2 km spatial resolution, 15 min temporal resolution, coarse-grained to 16x16 up to 48x48 (e.g., 32x32 / ~130 km)
